company.company description: Bayou Chocolate Delights specializes in hand-crafted pralines, truffles, and filled bonbons using premium couverture chocolate. The company serves the local market through a flagship boutique and online sales, emphasizing New Orleans-inspired flavors and artisanal techniques. Bayou Chocolate Delights also offers custom gifts for businesses and special occasions.
